source.description: A towering translucent glacier colossus with boulders frozen inside its body and glowing cyan cracks, standing immense and slow. Heaves with a grinding breath, ice creaking, cracks pulsing with cold light. Seamless loop.
The towering glacier colossus attacks — it draws both massive ice fists back, then slams them together toward the camera in a crushing blow that scatters ice shards, then grinds back upright.

_notes: v3 humanoid character (boss), south direction only. Base sprite approved pre-session; idle+attack generated via v3, self-reviewed (gate 3 pre-approved).
